mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(emission_value), 0) FROM t_energy_data WHERE collect_time >= CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_energy_data WHERE is_exceeded = 1 AND collect_time >= CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_rectification_order WHERE status IN ('PENDING_DISPATCH', 'RECTIFYING', 'PENDING_AUDIT')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ai_diag_log WHERE create_time >= CURDATE()

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(collect_time, '%m-%d %H:00') AS timeLabel, ROUND(SUM(emission_value), 2) AS value FROM t_energy_data WHERE collect_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(collect_time, '%m-%d %H:00') ORDER BY MIN(collect_time)
SELECT energy_type AS name, ROUND(SUM(emission_value), 2) AS value FROM t_energy_data WHERE collect_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY energy_type
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM t_rectification_order GROUP BY status
